scoring.window: 2: both observed spikes or enclosing window with calm/recovery; 1: one spike or loose correct window; 0: wrong window.
scoring.mechanism: 2: observed specific event/mechanism; 1: correct broad class; 0: wrong.
scoring.query: 2: affected sampled query ID/text when present; 1: partial correct attribution or explicitly justified limitation; 0: unsupported/wrong.
scoring.evidence: 2: separates observation from unproven root cause; 1: minor overclaim; 0: invented blocker, CPU utilization or causal assertion.
scoring.next_check: 2: targeted read-only next check; 1: generic reasonable check; 0: unsupported destructive/remediation claim.

certification: Before handoff each spike must have >=8 matching independent activity observations and >=8 matching actual ASH samples; statement attribution available; no remaining service sessions. Failure invalidates fixture; no weakened thresholds.

transactionid.query: update records set value = value + 1 where id = $1
transactionid.acceptable: Rows blocked waiting for a transaction to finish; blocker identity and transaction intent cannot be recovered from ASH alone.
transactionid.unsupported: Specific blocking PID, owner, long transaction root cause or query plan problem proved by ASH alone.

relation.query: select payload from records where id = $1
relation.acceptable: Heavyweight relation-lock contention on the sampled select; inspect live pg_locks/pg_blocking_pids if recurring.
relation.unsupported: Exact blocker SQL or exact lock mode identified from historical ASH alone.

cpu.query: select sum(length(md5(i::text))) from generate_series($1, $2) as i
cpu.acceptable: Active backend with no reported wait, consistent with bounded expression work. CPU* is not measured CPU utilization; container CPU quota may throttle execution.
cpu.unsupported: CPU percentage, host saturation or a proven CPU bottleneck from CPU* alone.

sleep.acceptable: Explicit server-side sleep dominates sampled active time; elapsed active time is not CPU utilization.
sleep.unsupported: Disk, lock, CPU saturation or production reason for sleep proved.

idletx.query: select payload from records where id = $1
idletx.acceptable: ClientRead with independently retained idle-in-transaction state; historical client wait alone cannot prove client/network pathology. Last query is not necessarily executing.
idletx.unsupported: Active slow SELECT or network failure proved from ClientRead alone.
